label: rem:categorical-hodge-star-remark
title: Involutivity of the categorical Hodge star
html: That \star^2 = \mathrm{id} follows from the non-degeneracy of \int_A and the involutivity of the antipode. The extension of \star to \Omega^k(A) follows from the graded Leibniz rule for S.
heading: Remark
